liftDiagnostics.method: Lift is (this crowd's percentile + 50) / (the usual crowd's percentile + 50). An area makes the top list when this crowd puts it at percentile 70 or higher and lift is 1.3 or more. Areas with little data are pulled toward 1.

limits: Lift compares percentile ranks within each response; it is not a count of people.

narration.summary: Neon Orchard, Sable & Sun and Kites Over Concrete at The Truth, Saturday, Dec 5. This crowd stands out from the room's usual crowd in 4 areas; the strongest, Beech Grove Farms, is about 1.6 times the room's usual crowd. The sheet suggests 24 partners of 8 kinds; none has agreed to anything. It also lists 8 spots for before and after the show, 4 podcasts and 1 sponsor brand. Compared with the room's usual crowd, this one leans toward R&B, R&B and hip-hop.

steps.label: Acts
steps.cause: The room isn't in Qloo's catalog, so the run uses the Ticketmaster map point.

steps.label: Usual crowd
steps.decision: Built the room's usual crowd from 12 headliners on its next 33 shows.

steps.label: Lift map
steps.decision: Put Beech Grove Farms first: about 1.6 times the room's usual crowd.
steps.cause: 30 areas pass both tests: at least 1.3 times the room's usual crowd, and percentile 70 or higher for this crowd.

steps.label: Map check
steps.decision: Split the bill's acts in two and mapped each half: the two maps broadly agree.
steps.cause: The two halves rank the areas alike: 0.59, where 1 means the same order.

steps.label: Partners
steps.decision: Kept 24 places across 3 top areas, at most 2 of a kind in each.
steps.cause: Qloo ranked them for this crowd, and every one is open Thursday. Dropped 8 places marked closed.

steps.label: Usual-crowd overlap
steps.decision: Marked down the places the room's usual crowd ranks as high; 6 places fell off the list.
steps.cause: Pruett & Daughters, Fairley Coffee, Bascom Coffee, Fairley's Kitchen, Atwater's Cafe and Hooper's: the same search for the room's usual crowd ranks them about as high, so they'd suit any night here. They come back only if nothing better is open nearby.

steps.label: Your list
steps.decision: Ranked 6 of your 8 places for this bill.
steps.cause: 2 aren't in Qloo's catalog, so they stay on your list in your order.

steps.label: Before and after
steps.decision: Picked 8 spots within 1.5 km of the room, open on show night.
steps.cause: Bars stay off fan copy: Ticketmaster lists the show as all ages.

steps.label: Podcasts and sponsor
steps.cause: All are labelled national: local ranking isn't verified yet. Alcohol, tobacco and gambling brands are left out: Ticketmaster lists the show as all ages.

steps.label: Summary
steps.decision: Wrote the summary and 3 fan copy lines from a fixed template; no model was called.

steps.label: Checks
steps.decision: Checked every line against this run's requests; nothing had to go.
steps.cause: Held back 4 tags by policy: none of them appears in copy or on this sheet. Kept 2 alcohol tags out of fan copy: Ticketmaster doesn't list the show as 21+.

steps.label: Without Qloo
steps.decision: Built a list without Qloo from 8 Google Places searches: 0 of its 20 places are also on this sheet.
steps.cause: No model key is set, so fixed searches by type, sorted by Google rating and review count, stood in for the model's own searches.

discovery.headline: Area 1, Beech Grove Farms, is 7th of the 13 squares on the map for this crowd on its own, but 1st once it's compared with the room's usual crowd.
discovery.detail: Looking at this crowd alone, you'd skip it. Next to the room's usual crowd, it stands out.
discovery.rule: the highest-lift numbered area that ranks at least 5 places lower when you look at this crowd on its own.
